The Award-Winning North Cliff Hotel offers stunning views of the pacific coast, spectacular sunsets, excellent service, and the amenities you deserve.
Superior Suite VIP Club:
Call to book a Superior Suite directly with North Cliff Hotel and be automatically offered membership to our Superior Suite VIP Club .
Call and become a VIP today!
All Suites have a balcony, gas fireplace, ocean, and harbor views. Spa Suites feature one of our luxurious robes to add to your relaxation.
You can hear the sounds of the harbor from your well-appointed suite. Relax to the sounds of the ocean and the distant hum of the foghorn. Experience authentic coastal life on our historic, working harbor. Come stay with us and savor the moment.
While pampering yourself enjoy some of the amenities listed below.
For a complete list of amenities click here .
Special Amenities include:
Romantic Gas Fireplace
Private Balcony
"Grab and Go" breakfast
Spa Suites Available
Limited Pet Friendly Suites available upon request ( view policy )
Adjacent to Historical Working Harbor
Please call our reservation line to reserve your room in advance.
Reservations: 1-866-962-2550
Enjoy the Fresh Ocean Air
(no air conditioning in rooms)
While staying with us you will soon discover there is an abundance of activities and things to do throughout Fort Bragg and surrounding areas. Take a romantic walk on the beach or a stroll through the town of Fort Bragg. Downtown Fort Bragg is just minutes away from our location.
California's Hwy 1 Coastline is well known as some of the most scenic places to visit in the world. So always have your camera ready to take some fantastic shots of some of the most beautiful coastlines in America. Please check out our "Things To Do" page.
Please Note:
Our Hotel is not equipped with an elevator.
